name: hero-ai-infrastructure

frames.best_why: Headline, paragraph and both buttons are sharp, with the badge and nav all in place.

tagline: Deep blue glow behind a three-line AI infrastructure headline.
summary: A dark infrastructure hero washed in a deep blue glow, with slim nav, a New badge, a three-line headline, two call-to-action buttons and a partner logo wall below.
appearance: A near-black page flooded by a huge electric-blue sphere glow that fills most of the frame. A slim white nav sits at the top edge, a small pill with a blue New tag above a three-line white headline, then grey copy and two square-cornered buttons, one white and one glassy.
behaviour: Elements sharpen and rise in a stagger when the section scrolls into view: nav, badge, headline, paragraph, buttons, then the partner logos. The blue glow behind drifts continuously and never settles.
demo_content: Headline 'Powering the Next Generation of AI Infrastructure' plus 'Trusted by 999+ growing B2B teams'.
search_phrases: three line headline for enterprise ai
book a demo and secondary glass button
logo wall under a hero section
b2b saas homepage above the fold
nav with register for free button
use_when: An AI or data platform needs a dark, confident landing hero with room for partner logos.
avoid_when: A full-viewport WebGL glow runs constantly, and the logo wall falls below the first screen.
customise: Copy, links and logo image URLs are inline; shader colours, camera and glow strength are literal props on the canvas.
weight_why: A full-screen WebGL shader runs nonstop behind the content.

a11y.note: The background shader never stops for reduced-motion users, and the logo mark has no text or label.

issues: The partner logo wall never appears in the recording, which stops at the buttons.
The grey paragraph is low contrast against the bright blue wash.
polish_why: Clean hierarchy on a strong blue glow; small grey copy is low contrast.
